release_1_winner.schedule_text: alternating A/B continuous: A 150 mg/m2 at 0.3 x full x3d, B 150 mg/m2 at 0.5 x full x3d, no rest
notes: single-drug arm is a grid of 26 calendars; the best is single-drug A: 150 mg/m2 x2d every 42d at median AUBC 1.3046 (dominance day 214) over 30 seeds.
of 24 alternating candidates, 4 are inadmissible under EVERY declared marrow weight and were not run; 20 were run and 12 are admissible at the primary weight 1.

at the conservative marrow weight 1 the best alternating calendar is alternating A/B continuous: A 150 mg/m2 at 0.3 x full x3d, B 150 mg/m2 at 0.5 x full x3d, no rest at median AUBC 0.0433 vs single-drug 1.3046 (ratio 0.0332); alternating WINS.
the verdict does NOT flip anywhere in the declared marrow-weight sweep, so it does not depend on the assumed potency of drug B.

1.0.note: the screen's ANC floor is the FDA label threshold; drug B's marrow potency per mg/m2 is an assumption and is swept, never set to 0.0 to make a calendar pass

0.5.note: the screen's ANC floor is the FDA label threshold; drug B's marrow potency per mg/m2 is an assumption and is swept, never set to 0.0 to make a calendar pass

summary.verdict: the alternating calendar's advantage and its safety bracket are both reported as boundaries; a cell that reverses or breaks the ANC floor is a limit of the claim, not a footnote to it
